name: AI Video Cataloger - GUI Rebuild as CLI Wrapper
description: Rebuild the Electron GUI from scratch to be a thin wrapper over the CLI. The GUI will spawn CLI commands, display their output in a terminal-like log viewer, and provide a visual interface for browsing videos and their metadata.

stories.title: Per-Folder Database Migration
stories.description: As a developer, I need CLI to use per-folder databases instead of global
acceptanceCriteria: Each working folder has its own database
Existing global DB is not migrated (fresh start)

stories.title: Bundle FFmpeg with CLI
stories.description: As a user, I want CLI to work without system ffmpeg installed
acceptanceCriteria: Extract binary on first use to ~/.ai-video-cataloger/bin/
Fall back to system ffmpeg if bundled fails
Works on macOS arm64 and x64

stories.title: Bundle Whisper.cpp with CLI
stories.description: As a user, I want CLI to work without system whisper installed
acceptanceCriteria: Use bundled binary when whisper mode is 'local'
Fall back to system whisper if bundled unavailable

stories.title: JSON Output Mode
stories.description: As a developer, I want CLI to output JSON events so GUI can parse progress reliably
acceptanceCriteria: Output newline-delimited JSON for all commands
Include event types: started, progress, completed, error
Progress events include step name and percentage

stories.title: Process Single Video Command
stories.description: As a user, I want to process a single video file directly
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts same options as main command (--frames, --whisper, etc.)
Reports error if file doesn't exist or isn't video

stories.title: Thumbnail Generation Command
stories.description: As a user, I want CLI to generate video thumbnails
acceptanceCriteria: Skips if thumbnail already exists (use --force to regenerate)

stories.title: Model Download Command
stories.description: As a user, I want to download Whisper models via CLI
acceptanceCriteria: Downloads GGML model from Hugging Face
Shows progress with percentage and speed

stories.title: Model Delete Command
stories.description: As a user, I want to delete downloaded Whisper models
acceptanceCriteria: Reports error if model not downloaded

stories.title: Config Get/Set Commands
stories.description: As a user, I want to manage settings via CLI
acceptanceCriteria: Add config get [key] subcommand (all or specific)
Validates known keys and value types

stories.title: Nested Database Check
stories.description: As a user, I want CLI to detect nested databases
acceptanceCriteria: Main command refuses to run if nested DBs exist
Clear error message explaining the issue

stories.title: Status with JSON Output
stories.description: As a developer, I want status command to output JSON
acceptanceCriteria: Returns array of video records with status
Includes all fields: path, status, error, timestamps

stories.title: Scan Folder Command
stories.description: As a user, I want to list videos in a folder
acceptanceCriteria: Lists all video files with metadata (size, duration)

stories.title: Prerequisites Check Command
stories.description: As a user, I want to check system prerequisites
acceptanceCriteria: Checks: bundled ffmpeg, bundled whisper, claude CLI, ollama
Reports status and version for each
Shows bundled vs system for ffmpeg/whisper
Suggests installation steps for missing items

stories.title: Delete Current Electron Code
stories.description: As a developer, I need to remove the old GUI implementation
acceptanceCriteria: Update package.json to remove old electron scripts
Document what was removed in commit message

stories.title: New Electron Scaffold
stories.description: As a developer, I need fresh Electron project setup

stories.title: Shadcn/ui Setup with macOS Theme
stories.description: As a developer, I need UI components with macOS styling
acceptanceCriteria: Use SF Pro font (with system fallback)
Add base components: Button, Input, ScrollArea

stories.title: CLI Spawner Service
stories.description: As a developer, I need IPC to spawn and stream CLI output
acceptanceCriteria: Return process handle for kill capability

stories.title: Terminal Log Viewer Component
stories.description: As a user, I want to see CLI output in the GUI
acceptanceCriteria: Scrollable log area with monospace font
Auto-scroll to bottom on new output
Copy button to copy log contents

stories.title: Basic Window Layout
stories.description: As a user, I want a functional window layout
acceptanceCriteria: Three-panel layout: sidebar, main content, terminal log

stories.title: Folder Picker with Nested DB Check
stories.description: As a user, I want to select a folder to work with
acceptanceCriteria: Run ai-video-cataloger check on selected folder
If nested DBs found, show error modal with explanation
Show current folder path in UI

stories.title: Video List with Thumbnails
stories.description: As a user, I want to see videos in the selected folder
acceptanceCriteria: Sidebar shows list of video files
Call ai-video-cataloger scan --json to get list
Display thumbnail, filename, duration, status badge
Status badges: none (pending), yellow (processing), green (done), red (error)

stories.title: Video Details Panel
stories.description: As a user, I want to see details of selected video
acceptanceCriteria: If completed: show summary, transcript preview, extracted frames
If error: show error message and failed step

stories.title: Analyze Single Video
stories.description: As a user, I want to analyze a video from GUI
acceptanceCriteria: Parse JSON events for progress indicator
Show progress bar with current step

stories.title: Cancel Processing
stories.description: As a user, I want to cancel ongoing analysis
acceptanceCriteria: Shows warning modal about potential incomplete state

stories.title: Batch Processing
stories.description: As a user, I want to analyze multiple videos
acceptanceCriteria: Analyze All button for pending videos
Processes videos one by one via CLI
Continue to next video on error

stories.title: Settings Panel
stories.description: As a user, I want to configure processing options

stories.title: Model Manager Panel
stories.description: As a user, I want to manage Whisper models in GUI
acceptanceCriteria: List available models with download status
Download button runs ai-video-cataloger models download --json
Delete button runs ai-video-cataloger models delete

stories.title: Prerequisites Panel
stories.description: As a user, I want to see system status
acceptanceCriteria: Prerequisites panel accessible from Help menu

stories.title: macOS Menu Bar
stories.description: As a user, I want native macOS menus
acceptanceCriteria: File menu: Open Folder, Recent Folders, Close
View menu: Toggle Terminal Log, Zoom
Help menu: Prerequisites, Model Manager, About

stories.title: AI Integration Tests
stories.description: As a developer, I want to validate CLI output with AI
acceptanceCriteria: Runs CLI against BigBuckBunny test video
Uses Claude Code CLI to validate: frames extracted (images of animated characters), summary mentions 'Big Buck Bunny' and 'animated', status shows completed

phases.name: CLI Enhancements
phases.description: Enhance the CLI with JSON output, new commands, and bundled dependencies

phases.name: New GUI Foundation
phases.description: Delete current Electron code and create fresh minimal GUI scaffold

phases.name: Core Features
phases.description: Implement core video processing features in the new GUI

phases.name: Polish & Testing
phases.description: Add model management, prerequisites panel, menus, and integration tests
